{{#if:{{{properties|}}}|{{infoheader|Properties}}
{{#if:{{{graphic2|}}}|{{infocell|*Rough gem: [[File:{{{graphic2}}}]]|}}|{{!-}}}}
{{infocell|{{{properties|}}}}}|{{!-}}}}
{{#if:{{{contains|}}}|{{infoheader|Contains}}
{{infocell|{{{contains|}}}}}|{{!-}}}}
{{#ifeq:{{{wiki}}}|no||{{infocell|style=text-align:center; background-color: #eee; border-top: 1px solid #aaa|1=[[wikipedia:{{#if:{{{wiki|}}}| {{{wiki}}}|{{{name}}}}}|Wikipedia article]]}}|{{!-}}}}
{{infoend}}</includeonly><noinclude>
